verdict.rationale: incident.io documents ingesting alerts from observability tools via 40+ alert sources plus custom HTTP sources, with named integrations for Datadog, Grafana, Honeycomb and New Relic. It routes alerts by team, service or other attributes into escalation paths with priority and working-hours rules, and alert sources can be assigned to a team. The evidence is first-party marketing and doc snippets only, and the condition-based routing configuration is described at a high level. Missing for 10: detailed docs on defining routing conditions/expressions on alert attributes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of ingestion and routing.
